TEMPTATION ||| Lean in closer, letting the tension thrum between us. ||| "What if I just told the truth, right here?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, holding the blade firmly in my grip. ||| "This isn’t the time for games, Julian."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze directly, revealing my uncertainty. ||| "I can’t shake the feeling you know more than you say."  
REVERSAL ||| Shift my stance, asserting my control over the moment. ||| "I’ll answer when I’m ready—no one dictates my truth."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, feeling the weight of the moment. ||| <silent, my heart racing>
